title: Speed + Front Squat Power
warmup: Foam roll 2 min, then 2 rounds: Tri-Planar Ankle × 8/side · Inchworm Walk × 4 · CL Dead Bug × 6/side · A-skip 2 × 20 yd · B-skip 2 × 20 yd
jumps: Front Squat 3 @ RPE 7, fast → Box Jump 5 → DB Jump Squat 5 → Pogo Hops 10
Power wk 1: no tempo, lighter bar, every rep max speed · 10–20 sec between steps, 3:00 between rounds · elbows high
strength: Full recovery, walk back · every rep 100%
Snap the hips · heaviest bell you can move fast
note: Power block starts: no tempo, lighter heavy step. Move the bar fast, then jump.
